source.document: Hyundai Motor Group service information; Opus ADAS Map inspection report (2023 Kia Sorento Hybrid SX Prestige AWD); Hyundai / Kia / Genesis Front Bumper Off Requirements and Blind Spot Bumper Off Requirements model-year matrices.
source.note: Hyundai, Kia, and Genesis share Hyundai Motor Group ADAS architecture and calibration procedures. Per the bumper-off matrices, specific model-years require or skip particular calibrations — verify against the matrix when scoping a specific vehicle.

general_requirements: Per Kia / Hyundai Pre and Post Scanning Position Statement: after a collision, both pre-repair and post-repair scans are required to test for DTCs in airbag, body, engine, powertrain, and ADAS modules.

components.calibration_note: Bumper assembly removal is required for the Vertical Angle Inspection portion of the procedure; the bumper is reinstalled for target aiming. Additional bumper removal may be required if aiming results are not within specifications.
triggers: Front radar sensor is installed or replaced
Damage occurs within the immediate surrounding areas or attached parts
A DTC for failure of calibration is present (follow diagnostic procedures first)
The recognition and detection function has a problem

components.location: Behind front bumper corners, left and right (junction-assist / front cross-traffic radar on equipped vehicles)
components.calibration_note: Front corner radars are present on equipped trims (typically newer Genesis and higher Hyundai/Kia trims with front cross-traffic or junction-assist). Verify the vehicle is equipped before calibrating.
triggers: Vehicle has been in any accident affecting the front bumper
Front corner radar sensor is removed, installed, or replaced

components.location: Front Bumper / Side Mirrors / Trunk Lid
components.calibration_note: SVM is trim-dependent — verify the vehicle is equipped before calibrating. Mirror replacement triggers calibration only when the SVM camera is integrated into the mirror assembly.
triggers: Body repairs or operations cause the focus of a wide camera to change
Any SVM camera is removed, installed, or replaced
An outside mirror containing an SVM camera is replaced
The Surround View Monitor (SVM) unit is replaced

components.component: Blind Spot / Rear Corner Radar Sensors
components.location: Behind rear bumper, left and right (rear corner radars)
components.calibration_note: Per Hyundai/Kia/Genesis rear corner radar service info: a blind spot angle check must be performed after any rear bumper accident. Per the Blind Spot Bumper Off Requirements matrix, rear bumper R&I also triggers calibration on most current models — verify against the matrix for the specific model-year.
triggers: Vehicle has been in any accident affecting the rear bumper
Vehicle has been in any accident affecting the rear quarter panel
Rear bumper is removed and installed (on models requiring bumper-off BSD calibration per matrix)
Rear quarter panel is repaired or replaced in the sensor mounting area
Blind spot / rear corner radar sensor is removed, installed, or replaced

notes_for_other_components: Per Opus ADAS Map listing and shop research: no published occupant classification calibration for Hyundai/Kia/Genesis. Standalone rear backup cameras (separate from SVM) do not require calibration on these vehicles. No documented parking sensor calibration.
